title: Roman Urdu: masala + ghee on credit
transcript: Assalam o alaikum bhai, Bismillah General Store se bol raha hoon. 2 carton Shan biryani masala, 5 tin Dalda, aur 3 carton karahi masala bhej dein. Udhaar likh dena.

title: Urdu script: tea, milk, sugar
transcript: بھائی مدینہ کریانہ کے لیے چار پیکٹ ٹپال دانےدار، دو کارٹن ملک پیک اور ایک بوری چینی بھیج دیں۔ ادائیگی نقد کریں گے۔

title: Mixed: soaps and detergent, ambiguous item
transcript: Faisal Super Store. Ek carton Lifebuoy, do carton Surf Excel, teen carton sabun, aur 1 carton Colgate. Khata mein likh do.

title: Drinks and biscuits, cash
transcript: Chaudhry Mart ke liye 10 carton Pepsi, 5 carton Sprite, 6 carton Prince biscuit aur 4 carton Slanty. Cash payment.

title: Rice, atta and daal
transcript: Usman Karyana. 3 bori sella chawal, 5 bag atta, 20 kilo daal chana aur 10 kilo masoor. Udhar.

title: Payment report: “bees hazar bhej diye”
transcript: Assalam o alaikum, Usman Karyana se bol raha hoon. Bhai bees hazar rupay Easypaisa kar diye hain, khaate mein jama kar lein.

title: Balance question: “kitna baqaya hai?”
transcript: Bhai Chaudhry Mart se. Zara bata dein mera abhi kitna baqaya hai?
